{{Quote|From the artwork Nuso Esva has chosen to surround himself with, I anticipate he'll deploy most of his forces at the western edge of the city, clustered around Setting Sun Avenue.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Setting Sun Avenue''' was a street that was located in the [[Red City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Quethold was [[Attack on the Red City|attacked]] by the [[Empire of the Hand]] and during the battle, Imperial forces entered the Red City and engaged a large group of [[Quesoth]] [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] in Setting Sun Avenue.
